olivia-sales: Hey team — PineBank POC just asked for the evidence bundle. Need: staging IPs, presigned upload, SOC2 summary, and a signed pen-test letter. Any blockers on timelines?

samir-se: Quick Q — if they want dedicated capacity for the POC does that change the evidence we provide or pricing? Need to tell procurement.

jessica-compliance: We can hand over SOC2 in a zip + ISO excerpt. Pen-test letter needs legal sign-off (we use the standard attestation template). I can attach the template. ETA: I can assemble the pack by EOD tomorrow if infra gives upload path.

leo-security: Pen-test letter: we can provide the standard attestation but we need the customer's signatory name + intended scope (staging vs prod). Also they asked for KMS separation — confirm if they require CMK or just staging key rotation logs.

infra-ops: Staging IPs below. Also presigned put URL workflow preferred for files > 200MB.

```
Allowed staging CIDRs:
- 34.82.12.0/24
- 34.82.13.0/24
SFTP jump host: sftp-staging.redwood.internal (open to their IPs)
Upload bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/pinebank-poc/
```

jessica-compliance: +1 on presigned. For the audit bundle we'll include: SOC2 report (summary), ISO 27001 certificate excerpt, network diagram (redacted), and pen-test attestation draft.

olivia-sales: Customer wants the pen-test letter signed by the CTO or CISO. Who owns that? Also they asked whether providing staging creds affects billing for the POC.

samir-se: Billing: no immediate change for hosted test. If they request Dedicated or On‑Prem we need to surface reserved capacity pricing — that's a separate commercial ask. I'll send a quick note to AE.

leo-security: CTO/CISO sign-off — legal usually coordinates. I can prefill the letter and loop in legal for signing. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys on Dedicated/Private only. For Hosted we can provide HSM audits and rotation logs. Please set expectations.

infra-ops: Presigned PUT example (expires in 24h):

POST https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/pinebank-poc/?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=...

security-bot: Reminder: redact any PII before upload. Files retained for 30 days unless flagged for longer retention. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policy/evidence-retention :warning:

jessica-compliance: Olivia — I'll drop the drafted pen-test attestation in the bucket once infra gives write perms. Also include a README with the scope mapping.

olivia-sales: Great. Can we get a single point of contact for PineBank to upload and a contact for legal sign-off? I can collect names.

samir-se: I'll introduce AE (maria@pinebank) to legal once we have the letter draft.

infra-ops: Gave write perms to `pinebank-upload@pinebank.com` for s3://redwood-evidence/pinebank-poc/ — presigned URLs still preferred for large files.

jessica-compliance: Upload checklist I added to the bucket: `README_UPLOAD.md` (redaction checklist, required filenames, sign-off flow).

leo-security: Final note — if they want penetration test artifacts (raw reports) we need an NDA addendum. We can provide executive summaries without the addendum.

olivia-sales: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'm pinging PineBank to confirm their signatory and to schedule the upload window tomorrow 10-12 PST. :thumbsup:

samir-se: Thanks — sending pricing note to AE now.

jessica-compliance: Will enqueue the bundle assembly.

leo-security: I'll prep the attestation draft.

security-bot: Automated: Evidence upload completed (placeholder event). If you actually upload, the bot will post the real event with checksum.

olivia-sales: ack :eyes:
